attempts.prompt:
EDIT ONLY THE PERSON in image 1. Image 1 is the exact original game portrait/card and the sole authority for visible features, composition, clothing and exterior. Image 2 is only the user mascot identity reference: a fictional yellow 奶龙 with a compact round head, short broad neck, solid black oval eyes with green rings and no white sclera, one small mouth at the actual original mouth position, and no human nose, ears or skin. If a moustache is present, the one mouth remains below it; never add a second gray slit or default mascot lip above the moustache.

SOURCE-VISIBLE FEATURES TO PRESERVE:
Dark olive peaked cap with a shiny black visor, gold braid and oakleaf detailing along the visor band, a separate upper gold eagle and lower gold wreath/cockade; the hairline is covered, with short gray side hair and sideburns visible near the ears. Dark brown eyebrows, no glasses, no moustache or beard, and a clean-shaven smooth chin. Dark olive high-collared tunic with elaborate gold shoulder boards, red collar patches with dense gold embroidery and one small round gold button at the closed throat.
Retain the actual source hair, eyebrows, facial-hair extent, headgear, eyewear, clothing and decorations only where visibly present. Do not copy a bare scalp or missing eyebrows from the mascot reference over real source hair. Do not invent features from names or biographies.

COMPOSITION, EXPRESSION AND LIGHT:
Preserve the nearly frontal upright head-and-upper-chest portrait, direct gaze and stern closed mouth. Keep the cap close to the top, shoulders cut by the sides and upper chest clipped at the bottom; retain bright frontal facial modeling, strong under-cap shadow and subdued highlights on the uniform.
Fit the existing collar naturally around a rounded chin and very short broad neck transition while preserving its original open/closed state. No long neck column, pinched collar, floating cloth, clipping or cream bib. Preserve exactly one source-appropriate mouth and expression.

BACKGROUND, FRAME AND EXTERIOR:
The complete rectangular source is opaque, with no transparent exterior, separate frame or note. Preserve its real opaque pale warm greige painted backplate, locking its color, brightness, fine mottled texture and soft edge vignette behind the head and shoulders. Do not invent a transparent cutout, replacement backdrop, frame, note, halo or smoke.

OPAQUE RGB WORKING PASS AND EVIDENCE LIMITS:
This is the authorized best-RGB pass. Source alpha will be restored separately only after actual visual RGB review, using the recorded source-alpha BILINEAR method without changing RGB. Do not request or paint a checkerboard or green screen. Keep all original opaque backing, cloth and paper solid; no interior holes, haze or see-through fabric. Fine cap and collar embroidery, the small cockade interior and exact shoulder-board detail are not reliably readable at 156x210. Do not invent readable writing, extra note rows, symbols, people or comparison panels. Keep full returned detail and the source composition; no watermark.
